collection_rule: group-balanced, uniform clip and nonterminal frame; first reset covers every clip with an 80-slot balanced bootstrap
replay_rule: group, uniform clip, uniform eligible replay start; preserve native history padding and done masks
evaluation: same GPU backend and raw references; full 40/15 denominators, original full-length normalized returns, failures and tracking errors; keep CPU engineering results separate
continuous_and_hardware: optional, separate validation; no hardware execution authorized by this runner
